lucy: Hi — can someone share the service-overview + model-health dashboard for eu-west? I keep getting 403 when I try to open the panel. Need to check model latency and per-region errors for onboarding. Thanks!

infra-bot: :gear: Ticket created: IT-3842 — Grant lucy observability-read (org 42). ETA: 2 business days. Link: https://issues.redwood.ai/IT-3842

jason: For logs/traces: Loki explore -> https://loki.redwood.ai/explore?orgId=1
Tempo traces -> https://tempo.redwood.ai/search?service=model-serving

olivia: FYI the eu-west model-latency alert is noisy during nightly batch runs. Proposal: bump threshold from 1.0s -> 2.0s and add 15m cooldown. Also switch aggregation to p95. Can someone open an alerts PR? Sample alert snippet:
```
alert: ModelLatencyHigh
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(model_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region)) > 2.0
for: 15m
```

sam: I'll open a PR in infra/monitoring and tag @olivia for review. Thanks everyone!

lucy: Thanks — got the link, will follow up after I have access. :thumbsup:
